shieldRush.stunThreshold: three successful knockbacks per target; later rush hits refresh
shieldRush.bossRule: no push or stun; damage only while in contact
shieldRush.damageFloor: at least one damage per advertised hit

swordWave.range: 180 to 243 by existing basic level progression
swordWave.width: 128 to 172.8 by existing basic level progression
swordWave.damage: existing 300% ATK with basic level and weapon scaling

feedback.chargeGauge: per-frame actual charge elapsed / level and empowerment threshold; yellow under MP
feedback.archerTrail: existing approved raster arrow samples behind actual moving snipe; wall stops projectile
feedback.archerLeap: 160px opposite aim/facing, swept wall collision, decoy/empowered preserved
feedback.monsterStatusIcons: 20px cells, 25px spacing, 4 per row below foot HP bar; separate row after burn/shock

healing.rule: ceil positive skill healing budget once per attack/cast/return event; do not re-round transferred excess
healing.fractionalHp: clamp actual HP, floor displayed actual gain; suppress popup below 1
healing.scope: skill healing only; damage, passive regeneration and ordinary reward healing unchanged

validation.browser: local synthetic accounts; keyboard, mouse, touch; CI reruns all browser scripts

art: no new artwork; original approved sources preserved
